name: Josie Lopez
concern: Senior Logistic Consultant is not a decision maker title. Unlike the other five staged, who are a VP of Finance, an EVP, a CFO and two CEOs, a consultant seat is unlikely to own payment or banking decisions.
alsoNote: Based in the Los Angeles area rather than El Paso, so she may not be the one attending the stand.
recommendation: Still worth a request, since she is inside an exhibiting company and costs one of 240 available slots. But her opener should ask who owns carrier and agent settlement rather than pitch, the same shape used for Transend Logistics, Anthony Orsi. If she points to a colleague, that is a referred introduction and worth more than her own seat.
